data.name: Alaleem
data.gender_notes: Alaleem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who imparts knowledge and guidance. Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-L-M’, meaning to teach or instruct. The name Alaleem carries the meaning “The Teacher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alaleem usually hope their child will grow to embody the teacher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wisdom, guidance, and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Alaleem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Teacher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alaleem total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: العليم
in_arabic.long_meaning: العليم هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يعلم كل شيء ظاهر وباطن، ويعلم ما في الأرض وما في السماوات، وهو اسم من أسماء الله التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، مثل قوله تعالى: "والله العليم الحكيم".

in_urdu.name: العلیم
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ سب کچھ جاننے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: العلیم اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ ہر چیز کو جانتا ہے، چھوٹی سے بڑی، ظاہر یا پوشیدہ، اور یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: "اور اللہ تعالیٰ علیم حکیم ہے"۔

in_hindi.name: अललीम
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह तआला सब कुछ जानने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अललीम अल्लाह तआला का एक नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह हर चीज को जानता है, छोटी से बड़ी, प्रकट या छुपी हुई, और यह नाम कुरआन मजीद में आया है, जैसे कि रब्बानी आदेश: "और अल्लाह तआला अललीम हकीम है"।

in_english.name: Alaleem
in_english.long_meaning: Alaleem is one of the names of Allah in Islam, derived from the Arabic root 'علم' (Al-'Ilm), meaning knowledge. It signifies that Allah has complete knowledge of everything, whether apparent or hidden, and is often mentioned in the Quran, such as in the verse: "And Allah is the Knowing, the Wise" (Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 32). This name emphasizes Allah's attribute of omniscience.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alaleem is a title of respect and honor in Islamic culture. It is often given to individuals, particularly scholars and teachers, who are renowned for their wisdom, knowledge, and guidance. The title Alaleem carries a deep sense of respect and recognition for the enrichment of human knowledge and for sharing it with others.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Alaleem is a testament to the belief that knowledge and guidance come from Allah, the ultimate source of wisdom. The name represents the idea that the pursuit of knowledge is a spiritual journey, an act of worship, and a means to draw closer to Allah. It also symbolizes the belief that knowledge is a gift from Allah, and that teachers and scholars are vessels through which Allah's wisdom is passed down from generation to generation. The name Alaleem serves as a reminder of the importance of learning, seek-ing knowledge, and spreading it to others, as well as of the role of Allah in illuminating our minds and hearts with knowledge and guidance.
